text:
Leah: Uploaded a 'lunar-graphite' dark-theme iteration to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/lunar-graphite. Intent: graphite base (#060609), soft card lift (#0E1011), and a restrained cool accent ramp. Need quick checks on legends, stacked bars, inline code, tiny badges, and focus states.
Jon: Quick scan 30 legend swatches at 12px are hard to read when there are 6+ series. Can we either increase swatch to 14px or enable hover-to-highlight? Hover seems less noisy.
Mai: Hover-to-highlight + keyboard highlight mode (list) sounds good for accessibility. Also stacked bars: the current accent ramp (indigo->cyan) has small lightness differences, makes adjacent segments muddy. Recommend a perceptual ramp with larger L* deltas.
Arjun: Agree on L* ramp. For sparklines at 8-10px, thin strokes disappear on 1x. Suggest a faint panel-contrast outline on thumbnails only. Example SVG tweak: `<path stroke="var(--accent)" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.96" /><path stroke="#0B0B0B" stroke-width="0.5" opacity="0.6" />`
Zoe: Micro badges (8px counters) fail contrast on graphite cards. Either bump to 10px min or add subtle translucent backdrop. Backdrop example: `background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);` behind the badge.
Leah: Will try 10px min first, fallback to backdrop if layout suffers. Also copy nit f4db tooltips say "units" in some places; let's standardize to "tokens" across console and localization keys.
Jon: Inline code in threads is faint. Proposal: switch from filled chip to left accent bar + semi-bold text. Keeps flow and improves legibility. CSS: ```css
.inline-code {
  border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-500);
  padding-left: 6px;
  background: transparent;
  font-weight: 600;
}
```
Mai: Good. For monospace blocks, keys currently use orange which collides with error red. Suggest keys = #CBB7FF (muted violet), strings = #9FD8A4 (soft green), numbers = #8ECFFF. Keeps errors red distinct.
Arjun: For focus states, table rows and cards need a visible keyboard ring. Suggested pattern: `outline: 3px solid rgba(85,170,255,0.92); outline-offset: 4px;` must meet at least 3:1 for non-text controls.
Zoe: Also add `aria-label` to chart toggles: `aria-label="Chart: hourly token usage"` and `aria-pressed` for toggle state. Screen reader context is missing today.
Leah: Good call. Another thought: add a per-user "Chart contrast" toggle in Settings (remembers per-user). Some enterprise folks want bolder charts only.
Jon: Per-user toggle is ideal. Keep it off by default. Implementation idea: `user.preferences.chartContrast = 'high' | 'normal'` and CSS tokens switch.
Mai: Color-blindness: for stacked bars, if we keep hue changes we still need lightness separation. I'll generate a Lab-based ramp and paste swatches in figma with labels lunar-accent-100..900.
Arjun: Tiny UX micro: for sparklines show a slightly thicker trailing cap for latest value (helps scan at a glance). SVG trick: `stroke-linecap="round"` and increase last segment by 1px.
Zoe: Copy nit again: change any "units" references to "tokens" in tooltips, API docs and Console strings. I'll open a small i18n PR.
Leah: Thanks f44d I'll update figma, swap inline-code to left-bar treatment, and post updated tokens + a tiny changelog later today.
Design-Bot: Design review created: DR-4675 - "Lunar-graphite: legend readability, chart perceptual ramp, code inline legibility" assigned to @Leah. Comments due in 48h.
Jon: Leaving a few pinned comments in Figma on legend spacing and badge examples.
Mai: I'll run Axe color-contrast and post results here after tokens land.
Leah: Appreciate the quick eyes. If nothing else, please drop :thumbsup: in the Figma file for the proposed L* ramp so I can cut a PR.
